say:1:1430249101:1.text: Just keep scratching the skin until it leaves a large enough scar...
say:1:1430249101:1.source_cn: 只要将印着印记的皮肤抓烂，像这样……
say:1:1430249101:1.male: Just keep scratching the skin until it leaves a large enough scar...
say:1:1430249101:1.female: Just keep scratching the skin until it leaves a large enough scar...

say:2:1430249102:1.text: So when they ask, I'll just say it was a workplace accident.
say:2:1430249102:1.source_cn: 这样就算他们问起，我只会告诉他们这是干活时不小心的撞伤。
say:2:1430249102:1.male: So when they ask, I'll just say it was a workplace accident.
say:2:1430249102:1.female: So when they ask, I'll just say it was a workplace accident.

say:3:1430249103:1.text: See! It's is gone. I should be able to get some Divine Dew now.
say:3:1430249103:1.source_cn: 印记不见了，我应该能领到恩赐灵露了吧。
say:3:1430249103:1.male: See! It's is gone. I should be able to get some Divine Dew now.
say:3:1430249103:1.female: See! It's is gone. I should be able to get some Divine Dew now.
